initial_state.presenting_narrative: A 58-year-old male presents to the Emergency Department with crushing substernal chest pain radiating to the left arm and jaw. Pain started approximately 45 minutes ago while mowing the lawn. Patient is diaphoretic and appears anxious. Past medical history includes hypertension and hyperlipidemia. Current medications: lisinopril 10mg daily, simvastatin 20mg daily. Social history: 30 pack-year smoking history. Family history: father had MI at age 62.

events.narrative: ECG results show ST elevation in inferior leads (II, III, aVF) with reciprocal changes. Findings consistent with acute inferior STEMI.
Patient reports chest pain improving from 8/10 to 5/10 after initial treatment with aspirin and heparin.
ALERT: Patient's condition is worsening. Heart rate increasing, blood pressure dropping. Patient appears more diaphoretic and reports increasing chest pain (9/10).
Cardiology has evaluated the patient and recommends emergent cardiac catheterization. Door-to-balloon time goal under 90 minutes.
CRITICAL: Patient is hemodynamically unstable. Developing cardiogenic shock. Immediate intervention required.

order_results.Electrocardiogram: 12-lead ECG: Sinus rhythm, rate 98. ST elevation in leads II, III, aVF (2-3mm). Reciprocal ST depression in leads I and aVL. Consistent with acute inferior STEMI.
order_results.Troponin I: Troponin I: 2.4 ng/mL (Reference: <0.04 ng/mL). CRITICALLY ELEVATED.
order_results.Complete Blood Count: WBC 11.2 K/uL, Hgb 14.1 g/dL, Hct 42.3%, Platelets 245 K/uL. Mild leukocytosis.
order_results.Basic Metabolic Panel: Na 139 mEq/L, K 4.2 mEq/L, Cl 102 mEq/L, CO2 24 mEq/L, BUN 18 mg/dL, Cr 1.0 mg/dL, Glucose 156 mg/dL. Mildly elevated glucose.
order_results.Comprehensive Metabolic Panel: Electrolytes within normal limits. Glucose 156 (elevated). LFTs normal. Albumin 4.0.
order_results.Chest X-Ray: PA and lateral views. Heart size normal. No pulmonary edema. No pneumothorax. No pleural effusion. Lungs clear bilaterally.
order_results.CT Chest: No pulmonary embolism. No aortic dissection. Heart size normal. No pleural effusion.
order_results.CT Head: No acute intracranial abnormality. No hemorrhage or mass effect.
order_results.Coagulation Panel: PT 12.1 sec, INR 1.0, PTT 28 sec. Within normal limits.
order_results.Lipid Panel: Total cholesterol 245 mg/dL, LDL 165 mg/dL, HDL 38 mg/dL, Triglycerides 210 mg/dL. Dyslipidemia.
order_results.BNP: BNP: 450 pg/mL (Reference: <100 pg/mL). Mildly elevated, consistent with cardiac stress.
order_results.Echocardiogram: EF 45%. Inferior wall hypokinesis. No pericardial effusion. Mild mitral regurgitation.
order_results.Urinalysis: Clear, SG 1.020, pH 6.0, no protein, no glucose, no blood. Normal.
order_results.Blood Type and Screen: Type A positive. Antibody screen negative.
order_results.Arterial Blood Gas: pH 7.38, pCO2 36 mmHg, pO2 82 mmHg, HCO3 22 mEq/L. Mild hypoxemia on room air.
order_results.Blood Culture: No growth at 24 hours. Final results pending.
order_results.Cardiology Consultation: Cardiology agrees with acute inferior STEMI diagnosis. Recommend emergent PCI. Continue dual antiplatelet therapy and anticoagulation.
